enriched_activities.desc: Lie in bed. Close eyes. Breathe slowly. Turn to left side. Pull blanket up. Adjust pillow. Turn to right side. Stretch legs. Continue sleeping.

enriched_activities.activity: waking up and getting out of bed
enriched_activities.desc: Open eyes. Blink. Stretch arms. Yawn. Sit up. Swing legs over edge of bed. Place feet on floor. Stand up. Walk to bathroom door.

Turn on bathroom light. Turn on shower and adjust temperature. Step into shower. Wet body. Apply soap and scrub body. Rinse body. Turn off shower. Step out of shower. Pick up towel and dry body. Turn on tap. Pick up toothbrush and apply toothpaste. Brush teeth. Rinse mouth and spit. Turn off tap. Wipe face. Turn off light. Exit bathroom.

Enter kitchen. Open refrigerator and take out eggs, milk, butter. Close refrigerator. Open cupboard and take out bowl and plate. Crack eggs into bowl and whisk. Turn on stove and place pan. Add butter and pour eggs. Cook and stir eggs. Turn off stove and transfer eggs to plate. Toast bread and spread butter. Sit at table and eat breakfast. Drink milk. Clear dishes and rinse.

enriched_activities.activity: getting dressed and preparing for work
enriched_activities.desc: Enter bedroom. Open wardrobe. Select shirt, pants, socks. Take off pajamas. Put on shirt. Put on pants. Put on socks. Put on shoes. Put on belt. Look in mirror. Comb hair. Apply deodorant. Pack bag with laptop, keys, wallet. Pick up phone. Walk to door.
Walk out of house. Lock door. Walk to bus stop. Wait at bus stop. Board bus. Pay fare. Find seat. Sit down. Look out window. Get off bus. Walk to workplace. Enter building. Greet colleague.

enriched_activities.activity: working as a health care professional
enriched_activities.desc: Arrive at hospital. Change into scrubs. Check schedule. Attend morning meeting. See first patient. Take vitals. Administer medication. Update patient records. Consult with doctor. Assist in procedure. Take lunch break. Eat lunch. See more patients. Write notes. Use computer. Talk to colleague. End shift. Change out of scrubs.
Walk to bus stop. Wait for bus. Board bus. Pay fare. Find seat. Sit down. Look out window. Get off bus. Walk home. Unlock door. Enter home. Check mail.

Enter kitchen. Open refrigerator. Take out vegetables and meat. Close refrigerator. Wash vegetables. Chop vegetables. Turn on stove. Place pan. Add oil. Cook meat. Add vegetables. Stir. Turn off stove. Transfer to plate. Sit at table. Eat dinner. Drink water. Clear dishes. Rinse dishes.

Enter living room. Sit on couch. Pick up remote. Turn on TV. Change channels. Settle on program. Watch TV. Adjust volume. Stand up. Go to kitchen. Get snack. Return to couch. Sit down. Continue watching. Turn off TV. Stand up.

Sit at desk. Turn on computer. Wait for boot. Enter password. Open browser. Browse websites. Click links. Scroll. Type message. Check social media. Watch video. Adjust volume. Close browser. Shut down computer. Stand up.

enriched_activities.activity: washing up and getting ready for bed
enriched_activities.desc: Enter bathroom. Turn on light. Turn on tap. Wet face. Apply cleanser. Rinse face. Pat dry. Pick up toothbrush. Apply toothpaste. Brush teeth. Rinse mouth. Spit. Turn off tap. Wipe face. Turn off light. Exit bathroom.

Enter bedroom. Sit on bed. Pick up book. Open book. Read. Turn page. Read more. Close book. Put book on nightstand. Pick up phone. Unlock phone. Scroll through apps. Read messages. Type reply. Lock phone. Put phone on nightstand. Lie down.
Lie in bed. Close eyes. Breathe slowly. Turn to side. Pull blanket. Adjust pillow. Shift position. Continue sleeping.
